bottom_line.headline: Fifteen names advance, but only ROKU and MTCH are ready now; six came from this afternoon's rule seats and the strength names among them are stretched — and the committee's case on MP is still exit.
bottom_line.paragraph: The morning's nine verdicts stand. The afternoon seated names no voice had nominated and advanced six: five for strength (BRZE, KSS, ETSY, RXO, BOX) and XOM on a reclaim seat; four of the five strength names sit 3.9–7.2 average daily ranges above their 20-day average and BRZE and BOX are on Valen's no-buy list, so they are the right names at a late price. In a NEUTRAL, DOWNTREND tape with dealer gamma negative, the group thesis ends if SPY loses the 760 put wall.
